## Result

Did the desktop restore correctly after a reboot? Describe what restored, what
did not, and whether windows landed on the expected workspaces and monitors.

## Commands run

Include the output of `hyprwake doctor` if useful. Remove private paths,
window titles, command-line arguments, session IDs, and other secrets first.

## Logs or snapshots (optional)

Do not attach these without reviewing them: snapshots and logs can contain
private desktop state.
